CHAPTER 1 · ITEM 10 / 10

Interaction, markets and government

Market failure市場失靈

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Recognize externalities and market power as possible sources of market failure; identify whether an intervention is motivated by efficiency, equality or both.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

外部性影響交易以外的人；市場力量讓參與者影響價格。兩者可使市場結果偏離效率；其他政策可能主要關心收入分配。

Externalities affect people outside a transaction; market power lets a participant influence price. Both can prevent efficient allocation. A policy may instead be motivated by equality, or pursue both aims.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A smoke restriction protects bystanders, addressing an externality. Food vouchers target low incomes, mainly addressing equality. 禁煙與食物券的政策動機不同。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A rule reduces pollution imposed on nearby residents. Its direct efficiency rationale? 減少居民承受污染的效率理由？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
